covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Cardiff Central, from the UK's national real-time feed, including Transport for Wales Valley Lines services that call there.

stations: 104 stations and stops: 104 National Rail stations across South Wales and the Valleys (14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2a).
notes: Cardiff Queen Street and the wider Valley Lines network aren't in the catalog yet.
